inputs.text: The “No Kings” protest is being presented as peaceful dissent met by state force, but that framing leaves out the basic responsibility of keeping public order. When a mass demonstration becomes chaotic, federal officers cannot simply stand aside; tear gas and arrests may be necessary to restore order. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. Grand slogans don’t place anyone above the rules or make every protester’s conduct beyond scrutiny. A free society protects dissent, but it also depends on respect for law and the institutions that hold it together.
